title: Northgate Cash Reversal Amount on a Consumer Return
content:
**Clause.** For a Northgate Rewards, Northgate+ Assist, Northgate+ Student, Northgate+ Monthly or Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the return this consumer schedule settles is the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first; the earning it reverses is the Northgate Cash earning that points to the returned line, and when no such return is recorded or no earning points to that line, nothing is reversed.

The consumer return reversal is the reversal share multiplied by one less the relief fraction, rounded half up to the cent. The reversal share is the earned amount multiplied by the merchandise refunded on the return, divided by the earning's basis (the earning basis recorded on that earning). The relief fraction is zero.

**When a reversal is owed.** A reversal is owed on the return this schedule settles when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, and otherwise nothing is reversed. The kept-units basis is the line's net amount multiplied by the units kept (the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line), divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line. A line's net amount is the amount charged for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount. Each return record reverses cash at most once, and an even exchange that refunds nothing reverses nothing.

**Worked example (hypothetical line of 3 units, net amount 300.00, earning 6.00 recorded on a basis of 300.00)**

| Step | Value |
|---|---|
| return of 1 unit refunding | 100.00 |
| kept-units basis of the line | 300.00 multiplied by 3, divided by 3, less 100.00, that is 200.00 |
| recorded earning basis | 300.00, which differs, so a reversal is owed |
| reversal share | 6.00 multiplied by 100.00, divided by 300.00, that is 2.00 |
| reversal | 2.00 multiplied by one less zero, that is 2.00 |

**Owed or not (same hypothetical line)**

| Recorded earning basis | Kept-units basis | Reversal |
|---|---|---|
| 300.00 | 200.00 | owed |
| 200.00 | 200.00 | nothing is reversed |
